María José Portillo Ramírez (born 8 May 1999) is a Mexican tennis player. She has career-high WTA rankings of 377 in singles and 229 in doubles. Portillo Ramírez has won two singles titles and 18 doubles titles at tournaments of the ITF Women's Circuit . Playing for the Mexico Fed Cup team , she has a win/loss record of 3–1.
